items.q: I don't want to say she played like Bob Zurke a man, but that was way, way back in the old days -- that's what people used to say

ctx.x: It was a 'Little Rock Getaway' approach, it was a heavy approach, I don't want to say she played like Bob Zurke
a man, but that was way, way back in the old days -- that's what people used to say, it was some old fashioned phrase, it was a very definite heavy approach.
